episodes.title: A Rose for Lotta
episodes.overview: Lotta Crabtree is hired by mining tycoon Alpheus Troy to lure one of the Cartwrights into town and hold him for ransom in exchange for Ponderosa timber rights.

episodes.title: Death on Sun Mountain
episodes.overview: Greedy opportunist Mark Burdette and his accomplice Early Thorne stir up trouble between the Paiute tribe and the citizens of Virginia City.  Ben discovers Burdette and Thorne are selling antelope beef to the miners and finds the price too high.  He offers the miners beef at a more reasonable price.  Burdette and Thorne retaliate by framing the Paiute's for attacks, by dressing as them and killing ranchers.  Based on a factual accounting.  Lorne Greene's first voice-over narration, and no landing constructed yet for the Ponderosa stairway.

episodes.title: The Newcomers
episodes.overview: John Pennington and his crew want to mine the Ponderosa land by hydraulic means. Ben is totally against this method and evicts them in short order. Hoss is given the task of telling Pennington's men to leave, but soon has a moral dilemma on his hands when he meets Pennington's beautiful sister, Emily. He soon discovers a heartbreaking secret...she's terminally ill; but their relationship soon leads to plenty of trouble for the Cartwrights.

episodes.title: The Paiute War
episodes.overview: Trader Mike Wilson attempts to escape punishment by the Paiute Indians after mistreating two of their women, by placing the blame on Adam.  A fierce war between the Paiutes and the California militia follows, and the Paiutes seize Adam as hostage.  Very impressive battle scenes in the this first mini-epic of the series.  This episode did all it could to stage the real thing; 50 Indians were used and 50 cavalry actors and extras were used, and the production involved three days of shooting on location.  This episode encompassed both the biggest cast and most costly stunts.  This episode is based on the factual accounting that occured in May and June of 1860.

episodes.title: Enter Mark Twain
episodes.overview: Samuel Clemens arrives in Virginia City to write for the Territorial Enterprise at the same time a crooked politician tries to lay claim on the Ponderosa.

episodes.title: The Julia Bulette Story
episodes.overview: Little Joe is infatuated wih saloon owner Julia Bulette, whom he imagines is like his late mother.  First episode to reveal backround details concerning Marie Cartwright, and inspired by the true story of a Virginia City madam.  Also, the first episode to showcase Michael Landon.

episodes.title: The Saga of Annie O'Toole
episodes.overview: Adam defends the mining claim of Annie O' Toole in a court presided over by Judge Ben Cartwright.  Annie comes to the Washoe Diggings with a claim to a mine filed by her beau, Swede Lundberg.  Swede has two claims and sold one to an acquaintance of theirs named Gregory Spain, creating confusion, that only Judge Ben Cartwright can make a ruling on.

episodes.title: The Phillip Diedesheimer Story
episodes.overview: Adam and Hoss assist a German engineer in developing the concept of "square set timbering" in the mines.  Based on fact, and the first episode not to include all four Cartwrights.  Hoss refers to the character, Emily, with whom he was in love with in, "The Newcomers".

episodes.title: Mr. Henry Comstock
episodes.overview: In a flashback, the legendary prospector arrives on the Ponderosa and participates in the founding of Virginia City.  Coincidentally, guest star Jack Carson played a teller at the Comstock Bank and Trust in the 1942 film, "Gentleman Jim".  This early classic was the second episode filmed.

episodes.title: The Magnificent Adah
episodes.overview: Virginia City is visited by actress Adah Issacs Menken, who happens to be an old acquaintance of Ben's.  Joe is badly beaten by Adah's jealous suitor, John C. Regan, who is bested in a fight with an enraged Hoss.

episodes.title: The Truckee Strip
episodes.overview:
Luther Bishop and Ben Cartwright have had an ongoing land dispute for a number of years, over a small tract called the Truckee Strip.  One of Bishop's employee's has a grudge against the Cartwrights and wants to stir up the feud again, while also harboring designs on Bishop's pretty daughter, Amy.

Joe meets and falls in love with Amy, in spite of the family differences and the two want to marry.  Just when it looks like the feud will end with the union of the two young people, Bishop's man attacks Amy and Joe must come to the rescue.

episodes.title: The Hanging Posse
episodes.overview: Adam and Joe reluctantly join a group of vengeful townsmen, who are out to lynch the three men who supposedly killed Vannie Johnson.  The posse is run by Paiute Scroggs and Flint Johnson, the dead woman's husband.  When Adam and Joe clash with them, they both separate and try to reach the three men before the posse does.  This episode's storyline is a variation of the 1943 film "The Ox-Bow Incident".

episodes.title: Vendetta
episodes.overview: In a variation of "High Noon", Ben and Hoss must face a gang of outlaws practically all alone when most of Virginia City's citizens go into hiding.  The most action-filled episode since "The Paiute War".

episodes.title: The Sisters
episodes.overview: This episode begins with Adam defending the honor of Sue Ellen Terry in a duel.  No one gets shot because the other man misses Adam and Adam generously shoots in the air to end the duel.  Sue Ellen lives with her sister, who seems nice but turns out to be fairly evil, consumed with jealousy because she's getting older and her sister is a young beauty.  When Adam drops Sue Ellen off after a date one night, half way through this episode, someone shoots her dead, and Adam becomes a suspect and is thrown in jail.  When the sheriff suggests that Adam escape, he does it, but when he walks out, someone tries to shoot him.  He chases after them but doesn't find them, and soon after hears Sue Ellen's sister scream.  He runs up the stairs to find her dead, and of course, is then suspected of that murder as well.  Of course, his family helps him during the last half hour, and it all turns out that someone we should not have suspected did all the murders, but that he actually wasn't trying to hit

episodes.title: The Last Hunt
episodes.overview: Hoss and Joe come across a pregnant Indian woman while hunting bighorn sheep and must deliver her baby.  Despite touches of humor, including a scene in which Joe refers to a meal as "cattle fodder", the story does not have an altogether happy ending.

episodes.title: El Toro Grande
episodes.overview: Ben sends Hoss and Joe to Monterey to purchase an expensive seed bull.  The first of Blocker and Landon's many comic misadventures, although the casual use of violence, as in the rapier fight, is oddly uncharacteristic for the series.  Hoss reveals his real name to be Eric for the first time.

episodes.title: The Outcast
episodes.overview: Because she is related to criminals, a young woman is ostracized by everyone but the the Cartwrights.  She unwisely seeks solace with an ex-con friend of Joe's, Clay Renton, and it's up to Ben to straighten everything out.  First episode to have a chapter title after the cast credits.

episodes.title: A House Divided
episodes.overview: As the Civil War approaches, Adam and Joe clash over which side to support.  The situation is complicated by the arrival of Frederick Kyle, a Southern sympathizer.  He was an old friend of Joe's mother and viewers also discover that Joe's middle name is Francis.

episodes.title: The Gunmen
episodes.overview: In the first all-out comic episode of the series, Hoss and Joe travel to Kiowa Flats, Texas, where they are mistaken for the notorious Slade Brothers, also played by Blocker and Landon.

episodes.title: The Fear Merchants
episodes.overview: The Cartwrights encounter racial bigotry in Virginia City and end up protecting a Chinese boy from mob violence.  Victor Sen Yung, in his largest role to date, speaks normally in the presence of his fellow countrymen, but reverts to broken English when with the Cartwrights.

episodes.title: The Spanish Grant
episodes.overview: In "The Spanish Grant", a young bargirl, Rosita Morales is pretending to be a Spanish noblewoman named Isabella Marie Inez de la Cuesta and at the end of the story, it's revealed she is really Rosita Morales, but on the other hand, is she really Rosita Morales?  This little twist at the end is simply entertaining everytime it's viewed, with the viewer able to determine the young woman's real identity at the end of act four.

episodes.title: Blood on the Land
episodes.overview: A shiftless sheepherder, Jeb Drummond, encroaches his herd of sheep on the Ponderosa and refuses to budge.  He resists all of Ben's attempts to throw him off his land and finally resorts to taking Adam prisoner in exchange for ownership of the ranch.

episodes.title: Desert Justice
episodes.overview: When a tough U.S. Marshal from California arrests a Ponderosa hand, Dave Walker, for murder, Adam and Hoss go along to make sure their employee reaches Los Angeles alive.  In one scene, Adam is dressed in black for the first time.  In another, Hoss, upon seeing Southern California for the first time, remarks, "It sure ain't never gonna amount to much".  Later, Adam makes an amusing reference to the chow Joe says he was forced to eat in "The Last Hunt".

episodes.title: The Stranger
episodes.overview: Nevada Territory is awaiting statehood, and Ben considers running for governor until he learns he is wanted for murder in New Orleans.  Inspector Charles Leduque arrives and says Ben is wanted for commiting the murder 20 years earlier, and after Joe kills his bodyguard in self-defense, Inspector Leduque makes it appear the other way around.  Ben has no choice but go with Leduque, to clear his name in a very suspense-filled episode.  Once again, there are several references to Joe's mother, and viewers are shown Marie's grave near the shore of Lake Tahoe.

episodes.title: Escape to Ponderosa
episodes.overview: After Adam is bushwhacked by three army deserters, Ben tracks them down, and tackles the brutal Captain Bolton who is pursuing them.

episodes.title: The Avenger
episodes.overview: A restaurant owner whom Ben and Adam have confronted over stolen Ponderosa beef ends up dead one night.  His daughter, Sally Byrnes runs the cafe and in her resentment, wrongfully accuses Ben and Adam of murdering her father and they are sentenced to hang.  A rancher by the name of Hawkins is also jealous of the Cartwrights and has hired his men to stop the town from helping Ben and Adam, ensuring they hang.  Hoss and Joe are willing to stop them, but Ben insists they stay within the limits of the law.

episodes.title: The Last Trophy
episodes.overview: Adam takes Ben's friends, Lord Marion Dunsworth and Lady Beatrice, on a hunting expedition, and they are captured by a gang of crude thieves and murderers.  During one early scene, after listening to Ben reminisce, Hoss says, "Always like to hear Pa get wound up.  He don't do it often."

episodes.title: San Francisco
episodes.overview: In this comic episode, the first to take place far from the ranch, Ben, Hoss, and Joe deliver a herd to San Francisco.  Although he warns his sons to be careful in the big city ("This is not the Ponderosa!"), Ben is the one who is shanghaied and must be rescued.

episodes.title: Bitter Water
episodes.overview: Len Keith, a miner, wants to purchase some land adjacent to the Ponderosa from rancher Andy McKaren.  Andy's son, Tod, is anxious to sell.  Keith has offered him a partnership,and more importantly, he is in love with Keith's daughter.  When Ben warns Andy that a mine on the property would foul up Ponderosa water, Andy agrees not to sell the land.  Len Keith, determined to get that land, plants tick infested cattle in a Ponderosa herd to turn Andy against the Cartwrights.

episodes.title: Feet of Clay

Gerner convinces Reed to hold her for a $1 million dollar ransom, and her father will gladly pay them to ensure her safe return.  Reed's girlfriend Della Thompson is jealous of Jennifer and has second thoughts about the abduction.  Hoss and Joe take notice of Jennifer's disappearance and travel deep into the bowels of the carnival, meeting fierce resistance from the carnival people at every avenue.  They come up without a trace of finding her.

episodes.title: The Kleebob Card Game
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche want to go to the movies and George and Harry want to go to the fights.  George tries to trick Gracie with a made-up card game called Kleebob.

episodes.title: Gracie the Artist
episodes.overview: After going to an art museum, Gracie believes she can become a great artist.  She begins her art career by painting a portrait of George.

episodes.title: The Property Tax Assessor
episodes.overview: George Burns delivers a monologue on how he met Gracie while she bollixes the tax assessor and frustrates George and Harry with their football knowledge.

episodes.title: Harry Morton's Private Secretary
episodes.overview: When Harry Morton hires a new secretary, Blanch and Gracie suspect that he has hired a beautiful girl. Meanwhile, a pretty high school student drops by the Burns home to interview George for her high school newspaper, Blanche and Gracie assume that the girl is the person Harry just hired.

episodes.title: Gracie's Checking Account
episodes.overview: Gracie returns George's Xmas gifts before he has seen them because he always exchanges them anyway.  The banker, Mr. Vanderlip has a talk with the Burnses about Gracie's odd check writing system.

episodes.title: Rhumba Lessons
episodes.overview: George and Harry need dancing instruction, but don't want it.

episodes.title: Happy Hmm-Hmm
episodes.overview: Looking at the calendar, Gracie finds that a date has been circled.  But why?

episodes.title: The Income Tax Man
episodes.overview: The income tax man gets frustrated trying to understand Gracie's tax deductions.

episodes.title: Johnny Velvet's Day in Court
episodes.overview: Gracie witnesses an car accident that involves gangster Johnny Velvet.  Velvet and his attorney try to intimidate Gracie into testifying in his favor.

episodes.title: Teenage Girl Spends the Weekend
episodes.overview: Emily Vanderlip stays with the Burnses while her parents are out of town and Gracie tries to help her with her schoolwork.

episodes.title: Live Show #19
episodes.overview: Gracie's old school friend Mamie Kelly visits the Burnses.

episodes.title: Too Much of the Mortons
episodes.overview: George comes to the conclusion that he and Gracie are seeing too much of the Mortons. He devises a plan to trick Blanche and Harry to go out of town for the weekend so he and Gracie can use the Mortons' pool by themselves. Complications ensue.

episodes.title: Gracie's Vegetarian Plot
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche read a diet book. They invite the author to speak at the meeting of their club, the Beverly Hills Uplifters Society. Gracie and Blanche are so inspired by the speech that they serve their husbands nothing but vegetables.

episodes.title: Space Patrol Kids Visit
episodes.overview: Trouble starts when Mamie Kelly and her three children park their trailer in the Burns backyard.

episodes.title: Gracie Prepares a Wedding
episodes.overview: Gracie invites problems by holding a home wedding.

episodes.title: Gracie Goes to a Psychiatrist
episodes.overview: Blanche is worried after having a string of bad dreams, but is afraid to go to a psychiatrist. Gracie decides to go in her place, pretending to be Blanche, so she can tell Blanche what the psychiatrist thinks of "her" problem. However, Harry hears that his wife is seeing a "shrink" and begins to treat Blanche better than he ever had before. Gracie thinks that if Harry treats his wife better when he thinks she's crazy, maybe if George think's Gracie's crazy he'll treat her better, too.

episodes.title: Beverly Hills Uplift Society is Out of Money
episodes.overview: Gracie and her Uplifters Society are locked out of their clubhouse because Gracie forgot to pay the rent.

episodes.title: The Football Game
episodes.overview: Football game tickets bring about complications for the Burnses and Mortons.

episodes.title: Surprise Birthday Party
episodes.overview: Gracie plans a surprise birthday party for George. The plan is that he is to invite all his friends to the Mocambo nightclub for a party but they are to decline his invitation, leaving him to think that nobody has remembered his birthday. However, Gracie being Gracie, things go awry quickly.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Gracie is having friends over for Thanksgiving dinner, including Harry Morton's business partner and his wife, Linda Lee. As it happens, a horse that Harry is betting on is also named Linda Lee, and Grace gets the two "Linda Lees" confused. Complications ensue.

episodes.title: New Dresses for the Concert
episodes.overview: The Uplifters society is having a concert and Gracie and Blanche want new dresses.

episodes.title: Christmas with Mamie Kelly
episodes.overview: Mamie Kelly and her children join the Burnses for the holidays.  George dresses up like Santa for the children and Gracie tells the children the story of A Christmas Carol.

episodes.title: Trip to Palm Springs
episodes.overview: George and Gracie are taking a trip to Jack Benny's Palm Springs home. Blanche wants to go, but Harry says no. Blanche doesn't accept "no" for an answer.

episodes.title: Gracie Loses Her Engagement Ring
episodes.overview: When Gracie misplaces her engagement ring, George decides to teach her a lesson.

episodes.title: Jack Benny Steals George's Joke
episodes.overview: A feud between George and Jack Benny is the result of Jack stealing one of George's jokes.

episodes.title: Divorce Attorney
episodes.overview: A prediction from a phoney swami results in Gracie engaging an attorney to divorce George.

episodes.title: Live Show #47
episodes.overview: Gracie has to renew her drivers license.
episodes.stream_name: Burns and Allen S02 E21 Dual Meanings.mp4

episodes.title: Live Show #49
episodes.overview: The Mortons invite George and Gracie to the Happy Time Lodge, but George doesn't want to go so he comes up with a story that he has to come up with $50,000 that night and he won't be able to go if he doesn't get the money. Gracie overhears this and, thinking that she and George are broke, plans to rent out their spare rooms to boarders.

episodes.title: Gracie and Blanche Want to Redecorate
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche want to redecorate their houses, but they know that George and Harry won't go for it. Gracie comes up with a plan to get George out of the house--she invites her relatives to stay for two weeks.

episodes.title: Free Trip to Hawaii
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to play cupid for Harry and her wardrobe woman, not realizing that the woman is married already and has two children

episodes.title: Dinner Party for Atomic Scientist
episodes.overview: Gracie gives a dinner party for a famous but somewhat eccentric atomic scientist, who never accepts invitations. However, the scientist hears that George was in Las Vegas at the time of the atomic testing and, thinking that George is a fellow scientist, accepts Gracie's invitation.

episodes.title: Gracie Worrys about George's Sneezing
episodes.overview: George has been sneezing for a comedy routine, so Gracie takes a medical exam for him and the doctor concludes she's mentally ill. Meanwhile, a dieting Harry Morton hides food all over the house.

episodes.title: Buying a Boat
episodes.overview: Gracie recruits Harry to buy George a boat. George Burns, Gracie Allen, Harry Von Zell.

episodes.title: Gracie has George's Portrait Painted
episodes.overview: Gracie hires an artist to paint a portrait of George.  But the painter is confounded when Gracie explains that she wants to give the portrait to George as a surprise gift.

episodes.title: Gracie and Blanche Hire Gigolos
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche complain that their husbands have lost their romantic spark, so George persuades Harry to pose as an amorous Frenchman to teach them a lesson. Bea Benaderet, Larry Keating, Ronnie Burns.

episodes.title: The Ballet Tickets
episodes.overview: Culture enters the Burns household as Gracie tries to get George to sponsor a ballet company.  Some interesting mixups occur, and the episode ends with George and Gracie doing a dance number without music.

episodes.title: Skating Pearsons Come to Visit
episodes.overview: A couple from George and Gracie's vaudeville days, "The Skating Pearsons" drop by for a visit. They're worried that their son, Joey, wants to get into show business, and ask George and Gracie to talk the boy out of it.

episodes.title: Harry Thinks that the Swamp Has Oil
episodes.overview: To get Harry to buy Blanche a TV, Gracie tries to get him to buy some swampland--but Harry gets the idea that there's oil under the property.

episodes.title: Gracie Writes About Silky Thompson
episodes.overview: Gracie tangles with the underworld. George Burns, Gracie Allen, Bea Benaderet, Harry Von Zell, Larry Keating.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks George is Going to Commit Suicide
episodes.overview: Gracie thinks George wants to get out of a complicated existence. Harry Von Zell, Larry Keating, Bea Benaderet.

episodes.title: Von Zell Dates a Married Woman
episodes.overview: Harry Von Zell has inadvertently dated a married woman, but Harry Morton is the one in big trouble when Gracie inexplicably (to our logic) poses on the telephone as Von Zell's wife and gives the woman's husband the Mortons' address.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks Harry is in Love with Her
episodes.overview: Harry buys an anniversary present for Blanche and hides it at the Burns' home. However, Gracie finds it and thinks that Harry has fallen in love with her and is trying to win her from George. She sets out to come up with a scheme to "discourage" Harry and show him that he and Gracie are not meant for each other.

episodes.title: Gracie Trying to Keep Mortons From Moving Away
episodes.overview: Harry Morton trades his house for one across town. Gracie doesn't want to lose her best friend Blanche, so when the new neighbors move into the Mortons' house, Gracie does everything she can think of to convince them that they wouldn't want to live next door to a household as crazy as the Burns' one.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks She and George are Not Married
episodes.overview: Gracie has acquired the crazy notion that she and George were never legally married.  Jack Benny, a witness to their marriage, visits the Burns household in an attempt to straighten Gracie out.

episodes.title: Mayor Brown Comes to Dinner
episodes.overview: Graice invites the mayor of Los Angeles for dinner.  Fletcher Bowron, longtime Los Angeles mayor in real life, plays himself.

episodes.title: George Jessel - The Cigarette Girl
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche are disturbed by their husbands' extracurricular activities:  Harry has been playing poker late at night, and George went to Ciro's with Georgie Jessel, who bought a teddy bear for $50 from a cigarette girl.

episodes.title: Gracie on a Train - Murder
episodes.overview: Harry Morton gets into trouble with the police as a result of Gracie's mistaken notion that a man she met on a train is planning to kill his wife.

episodes.title: Blanche Wants New Car / Gracie Gets Von Zell a Wife
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to find Von Zell a wife and children so he can save money on his income tax.

episodes.title: Swamp Party
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to help the Mortons sell their swamp.

episodes.title: Buying a Ranch
episodes.overview: Gracie believes that George wants to buy a ranch.  Harry Morton and his partner Casey want to be the ones to sell it to him.  But George does not really want to buy a ranch, and, perhaps ill-advisedly, relies on Harry Von Zell to help him get out of it.

episodes.title: George in the Army
episodes.overview: Gracie has the idea that joining the Army will be good for George, and enlists him.  George is not worried, because a doctor is coming to the house to examine him and he knows he will fail the physical.  At the same time, Harry Morton is applying for life insurance and also must be examined by a doctor.  Let's hope there is no mixup.

episodes.title: Gacie Reports the Car Stolen
episodes.overview: Someone whistles in George's dressing room and Gracie, believing the old show-biz superstition that it will mean three days of bad luck, hides George's car so that he can't make a scheduled trip to Palm Springs. George reports the car stolen, but eventually gets it back and sets off on his drive to Palm Springs--where he's arrested by the police because his car is still on the "hot car" list.

episodes.title: Gracie Pretends She's a College Boy's Mother
episodes.overview: Gracie poses as a student's mother so he can bring his girlfriend "home" to dinner. Harry Von Zell, Bea Benaderet, Larry Keating.

episodes.title: Buying a Mountain Cabin
episodes.overview: Problems arise when Harry Von Zell decides to buy a cabin from a real estate agent who is a competitor to Harry Morton, and Gracie gets the wrong impression that George is the one buying the cabin.

episodes.title: The Missing Fur Stole
episodes.overview: Lots of mixups, in both plot and dialogue, as Gracie mistakenly reports to the police that Blanche's new fur stole has been stolen.

episodes.title: Spanish Lessons
episodes.overview: Spanish lessons for Gracie and Blanche lead to George getting into some very unexpected trouble.

episodes.title: Gracie & Cleaning Woman / Vanderlips
episodes.overview: Gracie jeopardizes Harry Morton's bank loan and George and Harry Von Zell's well-being when she mistakenly determines Mr. Vanderlip has been having an affair with his cook

episodes.title: Von Zell's Old Girlfriend Visits
episodes.overview: Von Zell's college sweetheart is planning to drop by.  He has given her the impression that he is married, and Gracie wants to help him appear so.  At the same time, Harry Morton has been too much of a doormat to his business partner, Casey, and this relationship needs to be straightened out (by guess who?).

episodes.title: George Lecturing at UCLA
episodes.overview: George receives an invitation to lecture at a college, but when he overhears the Mortons and Harry von Zell making fun of him, he refuses.

episodes.title: Gracie and Harry Morton / Missing Persons Bureau
episodes.overview: Gracie gets involved with the missing Persons Bureau in trying to locate Harry Morton for his wife Blanche.

episodes.title: Surprise Party Mix-Up
episodes.overview: Gracie throws a monkey wrench into a birthday party for Harry Morton.

episodes.title: Cousins Perry and Pete
episodes.overview: George invites a pair of burglars to stay in their home after Gracie introduces them as her cousins.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks George is Going Solo
episodes.overview: Some amusement results when Gracie finds a telegram from 1923.  In it, George is asked to do a Broadway show, but without his partner.  Gracie does not notice the date on the telegram, and tries to figure out a way to make George feel free to do the show without her.

episodes.title: Gracie Trying to Get George to Go On Trip East
episodes.overview: Gracie decides that she wants to go to New York with the Mortons for a vacation.

episodes.title: Gracie Witnesses a Holdup
episodes.overview: Gracie has witnessed a bank robbery, and is scheduled as a witness against gangster Johnny Velvet.  George is expecting to sing at a dinner for Ronald Reagan, but the guest list is dwindling.

episodes.title: Locked Out of the House
episodes.overview: Thanks to Gracie's carelessness, the Burns and Mortons get locked out of their homes in the middle of the night, much to the chagrin of the locksmith's jealous wife.

episodes.title: Gracie Falls in a Department Store
episodes.overview: Gracie trips and falls, as a result of her high heel getting caught in a hole in the rug at the department store. The store's management attempts to reach a monetary settlement with Gracie, but are thwarted by confused resistance.

episodes.title: The Iron Deer
episodes.overview: When George declares he "can't see" how Harry Morton could spend $200 on an iron deer for his lawn, Gracie concludes George's eyesight is deteriorating.

episodes.title: Gracie Helps Harry get a New Account
episodes.overview: The prospect of Gracie being called for jury duty evokes much concern from all her friends

episodes.title: Gracie Gets a Jury Summons
episodes.overview: The prospect of Gracie being called for jury duty evokes much concern from all her friends.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks Blanche is a Kleptomaniac
episodes.overview: Gracie (mistakenly, of course) gets the notion that Blanche is a kleptomaniac and wreaks havoc by trying to cover up for her.

episodes.title: George and Harry are Mad at Each Other
episodes.overview: A mutual acquaintance ticks off George and Harry Morton, so Gracie thinks they're mad at each other. To patch up their friendship, Gracie decides to turn them both against Harry Von Zell.

episodes.title: Getting a Business Manager
episodes.overview: Gracie mistakes the Mortons' lawn man for the business manager she hired.

episodes.title: The Raccoon Coats
episodes.overview: After Gracie gives away Harry Morton's fur coat, she goes to great lengths to procure a replacement.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks Von Zell is Broke
episodes.overview: Gracie has the mistaken impression that Harry Von Zell is broke, and, of course, endeavors to help him.

episodes.title: Gracie Going to San Francisco
episodes.overview: George and Harry Morton plan to enjoy the fruits of bachelorhood while their wives are out of town.

episodes.title: Gracie Trades the House
episodes.overview: The Burns house is put in jeopardy when a mis-heard telephone conversation between George and Jack Benny gives Gracie the impression that George is quitting show business.

episodes.title: George and Gracie go to a Movie Premier
episodes.overview: Gracie and George get a limited amount of tickets to a movie premiere, and pledge them to too many friends.

episodes.title: Jane (Wardrobe Woman) and Her Problem
episodes.overview: Gracie creates a family crisis, because she believes sh e must have one in order to appreciate other people's problems.

episodes.title: Gracie's Anniversary Present
episodes.overview: Gracie decides to take flying lessons when she becomes convinced that George is planning to buy her a plane for their wedding anniversary.

episodes.title: Uncle Harvey's Invention
episodes.overview: Uncle Harvey's latest invention, a solution to make plants grow to gargantuan proportions, is found to contain the makings for a perfect martini.

episodes.title: George Reading Play to Be Done in London
episodes.overview: Gracie makes travel plans when she finds George reading a play due to open in London.

episodes.title: Gracie Helps Mechanic With Girl Friend
episodes.overview: Gracie has an historic interview with a local reporter.

episodes.title: Gracie Discovers George's Secret Weakness
episodes.overview: Gracie convinces herself that George must be in the class of the one man in five who has a secret vice. Burns & Allen do the vaudeville routine that made them famous, "Lamb Chops."

episodes.title: Gracie Has to Sell George's Car By Five O'Clock
episodes.overview: Gracie misunderstands a fire inspector's order to get rid of some inflammable rubbish.

episodes.title: Gracie Wins a Television Set
episodes.overview: A quiz show phones Gracie and offers her a TV set if she can answer a question. She can't, but she looks it up in an almanac, calls them back with the correct data, and demands a set.

episodes.title: No Fan Mail for George
episodes.overview: George is unhappy about not receiving any fan mail, so Gracie instructs Blanche to write a phony fan letter. Unfortunately this correspondence upsets both Harry Morton and the jealous husband of the woman whose name Blanche signed.

episodes.title: George and Gracie Going to Opera 'Carmen'
episodes.overview: Everyone is elated when Mr. Vanderlip invites them to the opera except for George, who's adamant about seeing a 3-D movie instead

episodes.title: Harry Morton Is Missing
episodes.overview: When Harry Morton goes missing, Gracie hires a private investigator who becomes very confused about the identity of his new client and her associates.

episodes.title: Gracie Goes to Psychiatrist for Blanche's Dream
episodes.overview: Gracie visits a bewildered psychiatrist for dream analysis, which unexpectedly results in Blanche and Harry Morton each believing the other is crazy.

episodes.title: Gracie's Old Boy Friend, Dan Conroy, Comes to Town
episodes.overview: When Gracie's athletic ex comes to visit, she swipes Harry Morton's trophies to pass off as her husband's. Further complications ensue when the awards go missing.

episodes.title: Gracie Tries to Get George in College/The Old Grads
episodes.overview: Gracie decides to enroll George in college. Meanwhile, George's production manager frantically searches for someone who can get Gracie out of a traffic ticket

episodes.title: Columbia Pictures Doing Burns and Allen Story
episodes.overview: Columbia is doing the Burns and Allen story and everybody wants to get into the act.

episodes.title: An Elephant Sits on Gracie's Fender
episodes.overview: An elephant has actually sat on the fender of Gracie's car, and everyone is having trouble believing her.

episodes.title: George Gets Black Eye from Open Door
episodes.overview: George's black eye and another man's broken leg lead people to believe the two men were brawling. Meanwhile, Gracie attempts to outsmart an insurance investigator, and Harry Von Zell tries to book a contortionist on the show.

episodes.title: Dolores De Marco, George's Ex-Vaudeville Partner
episodes.overview: To avoid a lawsuit, George dodges a man who spends the day patiently waiting on the front porch. Meanwhile, jealousy and mistaken-identity drive Gracie to extremes when the young daughter of George's ex-girlfriend visits.

episodes.title: Vanderlip Buys Black Negligee for His Wife
episodes.overview: Relationships are jeopardized after a meddling Gracie listens in on a phone call and concludes that Mr. Vanderlip is having an affair with a saleswoman.

episodes.title: Gracie and George Have a Mystery Anniversary
episodes.overview: Gracie throws an extravagant 9th "Hmm-Hmm" anniversary party, having forgotten the event that she's celebrating. A cook and butler hired for the occasion are bemused by Gracie's eccentricities.

episodes.title: George Resting for Insurance Examination
episodes.overview: George tries to get a full day's rest before his doctor's exam, but he soon finds friends, family, a telephone repairman, roofer and electrician tromping across his bed.

episodes.title: One Week to Live
episodes.overview: Gracie gets the mistaken notion that Harry Morton has only a week to live.

episodes.title: Gracie Buys Old Movies to Sell to Television
episodes.overview: George passes on an offer to buy the rights to some old films, but Gracie decides the deal would be in his best interest after consulting a psychic.

episodes.title: Emily Vanderlip's Elopement
episodes.overview: Although Emily Vanderlip has no desire to elope, Gracie pushes the matter until everyone's upset and Harry Von Zell is in police custody.

episodes.title: Emily Vanderlip's Elopement
episodes.overview: When a councilwoman asks for Gracie's support, she mistakenly thinks she's being asked to run for city council herself.

episodes.title: Burnses and Mortons Choosing Movie to Attend
episodes.overview: The Burns and Mortons decide to go to the movies but have difficulty finding a film that none of them have seen. Further complicating matters, Al and Harry Von Zell arrive and decide to tag along.

episodes.title: Gracie Buys a Toaster Wholesale
episodes.overview: Gracie needs a new toaster.  When George suggests that she consult a fellow club member who deals in wholesale appliances, Gracie finds that it is easy to save money.

episodes.title: Mortons Exchange Houses with the Gibsons from New York
episodes.overview: Harry and Blanche's friends from New York precipitate a housing crisis when they come to stay in the Morton house.

episodes.title: George Invites Critics to Watch First Show of Season
episodes.overview: George invites two newspaper reporters, while Gracie secretly invites two dozen strangers over to the house to view their opening night show.

episodes.title: Gracie Goes to the 'Do It Yourself' Show
episodes.overview: Gracie hires a carpenter to build a dresser. She then tries to fool her neighbors into thinking George built it by himself.

episodes.title: Gracie Gives Wedding in Payment of a Favor
episodes.overview: Gracie throws an extravagant wedding, but George can't figure out why his wife has taken on this responsibility.

episodes.title: Gracie Gives a Baby Shower for Virginia Beasley
episodes.overview: When Gracie throws a baby shower for the mailman's daughter, George gets stuck playing cards with Harry Morton's stuffy friends.

episodes.title: Auto License Bureau/George Becomes an Author
episodes.overview: Gracie tests the patience of a driver's license examiner. Meanwhile, George's friends lavish him with praise and gifts after learning he's writing an autobiography

episodes.title: George Trying to Keep Doctor's Appointment
episodes.overview: George has an appointment to take a physical exam, but each time he's prepared to leave a distraction pulls him away from his car and Gracie absconds with his keys.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks She and George Are Moving to New York
episodes.overview: When Gracie fears that they might have to move to New York for business reasons, she consults Mr. Beasley the postman, and concocts a crazy story about George witnessing a robbery.

episodes.title: Gracie Saves Blanche's Marriage
episodes.overview: After reading Blanche's fortune, Gracie concludes Blanche is in love with a man she encountered at the grocery store. Gracie attempts to intervene, dragging Harry Von Zell's name through the mud in the process.

episodes.title: Burnses & Mortons Going to Hear Antonelli Concert
episodes.overview: George tries to get out of attending a concert by getting Gracie involved with a jigsaw puzzle.

episodes.title: George Gets Call from Unknown Victor
episodes.overview: George gets irritated when Gracie mishandles a telephone call. She remembers the message, but not the caller's last name or phone number.

episodes.title: Harry Morton's Alumni Banquet
episodes.overview: Harry Morton's college alumni association is having a banquet, and Harry has promised them he can get George to act as Master of Ceremonies.  This circumstance plus Gracie's offbeat logic lead to much confusion, including Gracie confusing the staid members of the Dartmouth Club.

episodes.title: Gracie Thinks Bob Cummings Is in Love with Her
episodes.overview: Gracie overhears Bob Cummings reciting dialogue for his TV show and concludes that she is the object of his affections.

episodes.title: George's Mother-in-Law Trouble
episodes.overview: George decides to invite his mother-in-law for a brief stay, but a misheard conversation at the post office leads Harry Von Zell to spread word that the forthcoming visit has caused an enormous fight between George and Gracie.

episodes.title: George and the Glendale Eagle Publicity Stunt
episodes.overview: Thanks to Gracie, George is scheduled to take part in a publicity stunt. To get out of it, George claims to have a sprained ankle.

episodes.title: No Seats for Friar's Club Dinner
episodes.overview: The Friar's Club testimonial dinner for George and Gracie is sold out, but Gracie is intent on figuring out a way to get the Mortons and the Bagleys in.

episodes.title: Blanche and Clara Bagley Leave Their Husbands
episodes.overview: Gracie offers the Burns' guest room to two friends who are feuding with their husbands.

episodes.title: Gracie Gets a Valet for George
episodes.overview: Against her husband's wishes, Gracie hires a valet to help George with everyday tasks such as getting dressed.

episodes.title: Vanderlip Leaves His Parakeet with George
episodes.overview: Gracie decides to liberate a pet parakeet that George is minding for a friend. Bea Benaderet, Larry Keating.

episodes.title: Blanche's Brother, Roger the Moocher, Visits
episodes.overview: Blanche's freeloading brother comes to stay with the Mortons. Nothing is safe around him, including Harry Morton's clothes, George's cigars, and Harry von Zell's girlfriend.

episodes.title: George and the Missing Five Dollars and Missing Baby Pictures
episodes.overview: George's apparently compulsive behavior as he appears to be searching for a lost five dollar bill leads to trouble, as Gracie, the Mortons, and Von Zell all try to help him regain his sanity.

episodes.title: Gracie Becomes a Portrait Artist After Museum Visit
episodes.overview: Gracie wants to help George learn about art, so she visits a museum and gains enough knowledge to get mixed up about the subject.

episodes.title: George and the 14-Karat Gold Trombone
episodes.overview: A trombone entrusted to George causes a lot of trouble for the two Harrys.

episodes.title: The Romance of Harry Morton and Countess Braganni
episodes.overview: When Countess Braganni moves in next door, Blanche becomes convinced that her husband is vying for the countess's affections.

episodes.title: The Mistaken Marriage of Emily Vanderlip and Roger
episodes.overview: Gracie mistakenly concludes that Blanche's devious brother Roger is going to marry Emily Vanderlip, so Roger uses the ensuing confusion to try to extort money from George.

episodes.title: Gracie Adopts Great Dane Dog
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to help Joey Bagley by concealing his dog; meanwhile, George is under the mistaken impression that Gracie's Uncle Harvey is visiting.

episodes.title: Gracie Tries to Select George's Next Wife
episodes.overview: Gracie is under the wrong impression that she is ill and will soon die, so she auditions potential future wives for George.

episodes.title: Gracie Gets a Ticket 'Fixed' by the Judge
episodes.overview: Gracie's parking ticket leads to trouble with the law for George, Von Zell, and the Mortons.

episodes.title: Gracie Hires a Safecracker for Her Wall Safe
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to surprise George by having a wall safe installed, but she promptly locks the combination inside along with papers that he urgently needs access to. To rectify the situation, Gracie visits a pool hall to hire a safecracker.

episodes.title: Gracie Consults Dr. Kirby's Problem Clinic
episodes.overview: After a friend confides that her presumed-dead first husband is still alive, Gracie visits a TV therapist to try to find a solution to the predicament.

episodes.title: Gracie Wants the House Painted
episodes.overview: Gracie would like to have the house painted coral, but George wants it to stay white.  Once again, Von Zell and the Mortons get involved in a confusing situation, along with some befuddled house painters.

episodes.title: Gracie Plays Talent Scout for Imitator
episodes.overview: An impressionist impersonates the grocery delivery boy and wows Gracie and her friends, but when George contacts the real delivery boy to offer him a job on the show, he's baffled by the kid's lack of talent.

episodes.title: Gracie & George Try for a Day at the Beach
episodes.overview: George has an important business meeting at the beach, but Gracie thinks it's a pleasure trip and invites their friends to tag along. Unfortunately, each time they're prepared to leave, some interruption detains them.

episodes.title: The Uranium Caper
episodes.overview: An unsuccessful uranium prospecting expedition by the two Harrys sets the stage for a showdown between them and George over partnerships in non-existent mines.

episodes.title: Blanche and Brother Roger Move in with the Burnses
episodes.overview: When Blanche's brother shows up unexpectedly, it causes such a rift between Blanche and Harry that she decides to leave him. Blanche and Roger take up residence at the Burns' home, so George rooms with Harry, fearing his own divorce.

episodes.title: Gracie Believes George Has a Criminal Record
episodes.overview: Gracie becomes suspicious of George when she discovers an old picture of him in a striped suit. George doesn't help matters when he tells her that an old friend has escaped from prison.

episodes.title: Gracie Gets an Extension Visa for Jeanette Duval
episodes.overview: Gracie gets Harry Von Zell in big trouble when she tries to help a lovely French young woman with immigration problems.

episodes.title: Lucille Vanderlip Gives a Barbeque Party
episodes.overview: Lucille Vanderlip is planning a barbeque party, but George is convinced that Gracie is really throwing a party at home.

episodes.title: The Burnses and Mortons Going to Hawaii
episodes.overview: Harry Morton and George thwart their wives' plans for a Hawaiian vacation until Blanche's brother unexpectedly arrives - and then they can't wait to get away.

episodes.title: The Burnses And Mortons Go To New York
episodes.overview: George, Gracie, the Mortons, and Harry Von Zell are travelling by train to New York City to take up residence in the St. Moritz Hotel.  Famous atomic scientist Professor Eldridge is also on the train, traveling incognito.  Von Zell has an idea to pair the professor with Gracie for an ironic publicity photo.  But mixups occur as he and George try to determine which passenger is actually the professor.

episodes.title: The Musical Version
episodes.overview: George is excited as plans for his book to be made into a Broadway musical materialize.  This episode contains some nice music and even has some dancing by George and Gracie.

episodes.title: Ronnie Moves To The Village
episodes.overview: Ronnie wants to move in with his friend Jim and his artist father, who live in Greenwich Village.  Gracie tries to keep him from moving by emulating beatnik dress and decor.

episodes.title: Gracie Helps Lola
episodes.overview: Lola the waitress is having trouble getting her cab driver boyfriend to propose marriage.  Ronnie's drama teacher is coming to the hotel to meet George and Gracie.  These two storylines collide as Gracie does some impromptu waitressing at Rumplemeyers.

episodes.title: George Becomes a Dictator
episodes.overview: Everyone gets involved in Ronnie's acting dilemma:  he must choose between a comedic and a dramatic role.

episodes.title: Ronnie's Elopement
episodes.overview: Marie, the hotel's new cigarette girl, attracts the attention of all the men in the building. When she gives Gracie a vague message about Ronnie's tickets for a trip to Connecticut, Gracie assumes her son is planning to elope with her.

episodes.title: Company For Christmas
episodes.overview: Christmas is coming, and Blanche and Harry have differing ideas as to which family members they want to invite to join them in the St. Moritz Hotel.  The hotel is packed, and Gracie adds to the problem by trying to help.

episodes.title: Gracie Pawns Her Ring
episodes.overview: Ronnie's friend, Jim Boardman, has written a bad play and the boys petition George to finance it.  Gracie decides to help them get the money.

episodes.title: Appearances Are Deceiving
episodes.overview: Gracie has a problem to handle when an overly protective father finds his daughter embracing Ronnie.

episodes.title: Let's Dance
episodes.overview: Ronnie's drama school is having a dance, and Gracie wants to help out.  Von Zell tells Gracie that any man in the hotel would like to go with Marie, the cigarette counter sales girl.  This bit of information proves dangerous, as Gracie concocts a crazy scheme to sell tickets.

episodes.title: Ronnie Gets An Agent
episodes.overview: Ethically-challenged agent Jack Devlin attempts to lure Ronnie into signing with him, with the hope of landing jobs for his clients on the Burns and Allen Show.

episodes.title: George Needs Glasses
episodes.overview: Gracie mistakenly believes that George's vision is failing.  When he is reluctant to have eyeglasses prescribed for him, she consults an eye doctor.  He suggests that George might be worried about his appearence, so Gracie comes up with a ridiculous plan to make George see that wearing glasses is in style.

episodes.title: The Indian Potentate
episodes.overview: Gracie dons the garb of an Eastern princess in an endeavor to meet an Indian Maharaja.

episodes.title: Cyrano De Bergerac
episodes.overview: Ronnie is practicing the role of Cyrano, but has trouble coming to grips with a lack of self esteem resulting from comparing his own performance with a recording of the master Cyrano portrayer, Jose Ferrer.  Von Zell comes up with a novel solution, which  hinges on George's acting ability.

episodes.title: The English Playwright
episodes.overview: A famous playwright happens to be staying at the St. Moritz Hotel.  Ronnie would love to get a part in his current production, and Gracie tries to help in her typically illogical way.

episodes.title: Burlesk
episodes.overview: George is in trouble for supposedly influencing Jim Boardman to get a job in a burlesque show.

episodes.title: The Right People
episodes.overview: Mrs. Sohmers shows her snobbishness as she objects to a possible marriage between Ronnie and her daughter, Pat.  Meanwhile, Gracie suddenly rises in social status when she befriends prominent horse breeder Alfred Tyler Griffin.

episodes.title: The Magic Act
episodes.overview: Ronnie has been offered a contract for a part in a movie.  Gracie mistakenly believes that the offer is for George.  She decides that she must get a job to make George feel better about doing the movie without her.

episodes.title: The Paris Creation
episodes.overview: Gracie needs a slight alteration to a designer dress she bought.  George insists that she take it to the designer to have it fixed, not realizing that the designer is in Paris.

episodes.title: Back From Paris
episodes.overview: Behind George's back, Gracie concocts plans to bring twenty four of designer Broussard's dresses from Paris to sell in New York.

episodes.title: The Twenty-Four Dresses
episodes.overview: Gracie needs financing for the dress shop she intends to open.  George wants the dresses sent back to Paris.  Gracie counts on Mrs. Sohmers for help.

episodes.title: Ronnie Is Lovesick
episodes.overview: Gracie thinks that Ronnie is planning to join the French Foreign Legion because his French girlfriend left him.

episodes.title: The Night Out
episodes.overview: George gets locked in a steam room overnight.  Harry Von Zell has borrowed George's overcoat to wear on a date with a young woman and leaves it at the Stork Club.  These two circumstances result in a big misunderstanding between George and Gracie.

episodes.title: Questions And Answers
episodes.overview: In order to become a member of the Ladies of Oyster Bay, Gracie must be quizzed on her knowledge of literature by a committee of members.  Mrs. Sohmers comes up with a surprising plan to help her, but complications arise.

episodes.title: The Triple Surprise Party
episodes.overview: George gives a surprise party for Harry Morton but pretends it's for Ronnie. Larry Keating, Bea Benaderet, Ronnie Burns.

episodes.title: Mrs. Sohmers Needs a Psychiatrist
episodes.overview: Dabbs Greer plays a psychologist who is helping Mrs. Sohmers cope with anxiety created by her association with Gracie.  Then he meets Gracie and is thrown for a loop.  This episode features identity mixups of Blanche with Gracie, and George with Von Zell.

episodes.title: The Switchboard Operators
episodes.overview: In an effort to keep Harry Morton from accepting a new position which would involve extensive travel, Gracie and Blanche take over the hotel switchboard.

episodes.title: The Shakespearean Paper
episodes.overview: Ronnie has an assignment to write a paper on his favorite Shakespearean play.  Unfortunately, Harry Von Zell inspires Gracie to meddle, and the results are disastrous for Ronnie.

episodes.title: The Interview
episodes.overview: Two separate plots in this episode:  George is interviewed by a bewildered TV Guide writer and Mrs. Sohmers, on a visit to Beverly Hills, wants to meet her favorite actor, Francis X. Bushman.

episodes.title: The Initiation
episodes.overview: Mrs. Sohmers is staying with the Mortons while she looks for a house to buy in Pasadena.  She specifically wants to avoid living too close to Gracie.  Concurrently, Ronnie is undergoing a fraternity initiation which requires him to say and do the opposite of what anyone would expect.

episodes.title: Ronnie's Bashful
episodes.overview: Von Zell is dating a 28 year old woman, which evokes much  analysis and criticism from George and Gracie.  And when Ronnie stays home instead of attending a dance, Gracie gets the impression it is due to his shyness, and comes up with a crazy scheme to help him.

episodes.title: The Big Stamp Robbery
episodes.overview: Eager to find a stamp to mail a letter, Gracie ransacks Harry Morton's priceless collection.

episodes.title: George's Gray Suit
episodes.overview: Gracie ships George's new gray suit to Roger, but when George gets wind of it, he intercepts the package. Meanwhile, Gracie concocts a phony story about a burglary and gets everyone involved - even the police.

episodes.title: Von Zell's Raises
episodes.overview: Von Zell is happy to remain a bachelor, but rumors of an impending marriage prompt George to give him raises at just the wrong time.

episodes.title: The Refrigerator Salesman
episodes.overview: Ronnie has a temporary job selling electric razors in the Wilshire Department Store for the Christmas season.  Through Gracie's meddling and some misunderstandings, he becomes an ace refrigerator salesman, and this has quite an impact on George.

episodes.title: The Girl Behind The Perfume Counter
episodes.overview: Gracie mistakenly believes that Ronnie is dating an older woman, and constructs one of her off-beat strategies to amend the situation.

episodes.title: Ronnie Quits College Because His Father Goes Broke
episodes.overview: Gracie thinks she can prevent Ronnie from quitting college by demonstrating to him that George has suffered financially by not having a college education.  With the help of Harry Von Zell, she fabricates a sensational story that has the Mortons and Mrs. Sohmers in an uproar.

episodes.title: Christmas In Jail
episodes.overview: In flashback mode, George tells the story of how he became incarcerated on Christmas Eve.  The issue of Christmas gifts has once again seriously complicated George's life.

episodes.title: The Costume Party
episodes.overview: Von Zell, Harry Morton, and George throw a party to interest banker Mr. Vanderlip in an investment.  Blanche's brother Roger influences the outcome.

episodes.title: Gracie And The Bullfighter
episodes.overview: George and Gracie decide to show an interest in Ronnie's hobbies---until he takes up bullfighting. Ronnie Burns, Harry Von Zell, Bea Benaderet, Larry Keating.

episodes.title: The Ugly Duckling
episodes.overview: Gracie turns a wallflower coed into a beauty and gets her a date with Ronnie. But he has other plans. George Burns, Gracie Allen.

episodes.title: The Aptitude Test
episodes.overview: Gracie gets George to take an aptitude test "to help him find himself." Ronnie Burns, Harry Von Zell, Bea Benaderet, Larry Keating.

episodes.title: The Matrimonial Bureau
episodes.overview: Gracie gets a crazy idea that she must find a wife for Ronnie before he reaches the age of twenty one.  When she enlists the aid of a matrimonial bureau, George and Von Zell get embroiled in the ensuing mixup.

episodes.title: The Fortune Teller
episodes.overview: Gracie takes a fortune teller at her word when informed George is due for a financial windfall.

episodes.title: The Termites
episodes.overview: Gracie wants to have the bedroom redecorated without George's knowledge, but runs into some difficulty getting George out of the house for the required two days.  Ralph comes up with a novel solution.

episodes.title: The $15,000 Error
episodes.overview: Fearful of a huge redecorating bill, Gracie decides to mortgage the house. Gracie Allen, Larry Keating, Bea Benaderet.

episodes.title: The Ring
episodes.overview: In this episode, we meet Mr. Jansen the plumber, who comes to retrieve Gracie's lost engagement ring.  But the ring is not where he expects it to be.  George attempts to have some fun by telling lonely Mr. Jansen that Blanche is an eligible widow, but the results are not what George envisioned.

episodes.title: The Plumber's Friend
episodes.overview: Gracie plays hostess to plumber Mr. Jansen's four daughters, Jean, Joan, June and Joy, while he travels to San Diego to meet an eligible widow.  This causes a bit of trouble for Ronnie, who is already having problems with his girfriend, Kathy, due to her jealousy.

episodes.title: Going To Houston
episodes.overview: Gracie meets Brian McAfee in this episode, and attempts to convince his father that Brian should stay in college.

episodes.title: The Plumber's Union
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to help Mr. Jansen find a wife by placing a personal ad.  She misrepresents his age by about fifteen years, and this brings about some confusion.

episodes.title: Harry's Homecoming
episodes.overview: Gracie and Blanche feel that their husbands are not romantic enough.  Harry comes home a day early from his business trip and George instigates a crazy impersonation scheme involving Harry and Blanche.

episodes.title: The Publicity Romance
episodes.overview: The movie company for which Ronnie is working has created rumors of a romance between him and an Italian actress for publicity purposes.  His real girlfriend, Kathy, has a hard time accepting this.

episodes.title: The Texan Lady Macbeth
episodes.overview: Bonnie Sue McAfee, Brian's sister, has arrived in Hollywood with the intention of becoming a motion picture actress.  After speaking with Brian, Gracie embarks on a crazy plan to discourage Bonnie Sue from show business.  Bonnie Sue demonstrates her acting ability and supposed lack of Texas accent by performing a scene from Macbeth.

episodes.title: Ronnie's Boat
episodes.overview: Gracie tries to convince George to help Ronnie buy a boat. George Burns, Gracie Allen, Ronnie Burns.

episodes.title: A Trip To Tahiti
episodes.overview: Ronnie and Ralph are planning to sail to Tahiti in Ronnie's boat.  George's authorization of the questionable trip becomes a controversial issue.  Gracie gets Von Zell and the Mortons involved in the polemic, while June and Joy Jansen pay an important visit to the Burns household.

episodes.title: The Home Graduation
episodes.overview: It looks like Brian McAfee once again is not going to graduate, and this may be his last chance.  Gracie gets an idea for helping Brian when she listens to Harry Morton's story of how he was awarded his Dartmouth diploma in absentia.

episodes.title: Blanche's Mother Arrives
episodes.overview: Blanche's mother comes to visit, amid some turbulence in the Morton household due to Harry's cancelled business trip.  Gracie initiates another identity mixup, this time between Natalie (Blanche's mother) and Marie, a French exchange student at Ronnie's college.

episodes.title: The Wading Pool At Acapulco
episodes.overview: Ronnie and Ralph have a potential job as lifeguards at an Acapulco hotel.  Gracie wants George to go to Acapulco also, but he is not interested, and has to find a way to get out of it.

episodes.title: A Pain In The Back
episodes.overview: George feigns a bad back in order to avoid going fishing with Harry Morton, despite Gracie and Blanche's plan to get the two husbands to become friends.  Meanwhile, Ronnie and Ralph are contemplating going to a Calypso party.

episodes.title: The Rivals
episodes.overview: David has a rival, and his name is Will Thornberry - his next door neighbor.

episodes.title: The Poet
episodes.overview: Ozzie and Harriet read the newspaper and talk about Nancy Walker.

episodes.title: The Pills
episodes.overview: Ozzie decides to diet so he can fit into a pair of size 33 pants.

episodes.title: The Fall Guy
episodes.overview: Ozzie quickly regrets advising David against allowing people to take advantage of his good nature.

episodes.title: Halloween Party
episodes.overview: On Halloween night, Ozzie and Thorny make plans to attend a non-costume party as Satan and a Scotsman. Meanwhile Ricky and David attend a Halloween Party at school and the Nelson household is besieged by children demanding candy - or else.

episodes.title: Riviera Ballet
episodes.overview: Ozzie has tickets to the Riviera Ballet, but Harriet doesn't want him to go because the actresses will be wearing skimpy bathing suits.

episodes.title: David the Babysitter
episodes.overview: David gets a babysitting job and Ozzie is worried about David and the baby.

episodes.title: Rick Goes To A Dance
episodes.overview: Ricky receives a perfumed letter from his neighbor, Julie Thornberry, inviting him to his first dance.
episodes.stream_name: Season 01/S01E08 - Rick Goes to a Dance.mp4

episodes.title: Day After Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Having come home the previous day from Aunt Ellen's without any Thanksgiving leftovers, Ozzie and the boys become obsessed with a craving for more turkey

episodes.title: Thorny's Gift
episodes.overview: Ozzie is outraged after he doesn't receive a timely 'thank you' for the birthday gift he sent to Thorny.

episodes.title: Harriet's Hairdo
episodes.overview: Harriet decides to try a new hair style but it doesn't go over well with the Nelson men. Ozzie gently tries to suggest he wants her to go back to the look he's used to.

episodes.title: The Boys' Christmas Money
episodes.overview: The boys want to earn extra money for Christmas, so Ozzie gives them permission to look for work.

episodes.title: The Late Christmas Gift
episodes.overview: Ozzie and David receive Christmas gifts after Christmas from Grandma Nelson.

episodes.title: Newspaper Write-up
episodes.overview: Ozzie becomes upset, and increasingly obsessed, by a newspaper tribute to him that messes up his name.

episodes.title: Basketball Players
episodes.overview: Ozzie and Thorny's discussion about basketball escalates until they challenge each other to a game. They include their sons in the grudge match but then begin having second thoughts.

episodes.title: Stop Worrying
episodes.overview: Ozzie discovers his family worrying about different things, and admonishes them, as well as rationalizing them out of their concerns. But later he reads a magazine article and seems to have trouble fighting off worry himself.

episodes.title: The Tuba Affair
episodes.overview: Ozzie wants to establish that he's head-of-the-household, and Harriet wants to be a good wife. Marital strife ensues.

episodes.title: The Rover Boys
episodes.overview: While discussing The Rover Boys' books with Thorny, Ozzie takes off to check out a book at the library, hoping to prove Thorny wrong. But when he's caught with a big book, one of his boys' teachers is convinced he knows a lot about the Peloponnesian War and asks him to lead a book discussion. Ozzie is just too proud to admit the truth and decides to learn everything he can before the PTA meeting.

episodes.title: Separate Rooms
episodes.overview: David and Ricky finally get their own separate rooms - with hilarious results.

episodes.title: The Valentine Show
episodes.overview: Ozzie and Harriet are concerned that David will blow all the money he's saved on a new girl he's taking to a Valentine's Day dance.

episodes.title: The Traffic Signal
episodes.overview: There's a new traffic signal, and no one knows who should take the credit or get the blame.

episodes.title: The Dental Receptionist
episodes.overview: Ozzie soon regrets a flirtatious moment shared with his dentist's new southern belle receptionist.

episodes.title: The Speech

episodes.title: Treachery of Mars
episodes.overview: Buzz Corry, the Commander of the Space Patrol is in route from the planet Terra to Earth. He is accompanied by Cadet Happy, a new Cadet and winner of the Corry Scholarship. They spot what appears to be a derelict guided missile. As they move to destroy the derelict, its engines fire and the missile launches toward the commander's craft. The missile narrowly misses and changes course to intercept. In reality, the missile is a disguised ""cosmic"" bomb controlled by Major Gorla from his fortress on Kars. The Major is assisted by Matra, an assistant to Terra' Secretary General. Together they plan to conquer the United Planets beginning with the murder of Commander Corry.

episodes.title: The Lethal Lady
episodes.overview: Marta enlists the aid of Lt. Krasnoff a disgruntled Space Patrol to steal top secret materials and to destroy Commander Corry. Krasnoff holds a grudge against Major ""Robbie"" Robertson, United Planets Security Chief. Krasnoff paralyzes the Major with a ray gun and disengages the magnetic force control causing Buzz and Happy's rocketship out if control and into freefall seconds before landing.

episodes.title: Intrigue in the Cabinet
episodes.overview: Cabinet member Baron Von Kreitz hatches a plot to overthrow the General Secretary of the United Planets. The Baron sends Lt. Groat to prevent Commander Corry from delivering a report on Venus to the General Secretary. The information is passed to the Assistant Security Chief Tonga, who is wounded and partially paralyzed and imprisoned in the aft compartment of her space car. She manages to activate the ship's magnetizer, leaving a cosmic static trail. This signal allows Commander Corry and Cadet Happy to track her space car to the Baron's hideout on Earth's moon.

episodes.title: The Agra Ray
episodes.overview: Carol Carlisle, the daughter of the Secretary General, is testing her invention she calls the ""Agra Ray."" The radiation from the device enables plants to reach full maturity within a number of hours. However, the ray may be perverted into a powerful weapon with the capability of turning entire cities into stone. Unknown to Ms Carlisle, her assistant is agent of Prince Greegor of Mercury. The lab assistant steals the Agra Ray and kidnaps Ms Carlisle, transporting them to Mercury, where Prince Greegor plans to threaten Terra, the Capitol of the United Planets.

episodes.title: The Ivy of Death
episodes.overview: Due to an extreme food shortage in the Juniper system, Major Robertson and Tonga are to transport the Agra Ray to prevent starvation in the colonies. They are met by the sinister Goron, posing as the Agricultural minister, He leads the to his headquarters at the foot of Cornicus' crater. He plans to steal the Agra Ray to force the growth of the ""ivy of death."" The vines give off a suffocating dioxide which he plans to use in destroying the Unite Planets.

episodes.title: Trouble on Saturn's Third Moon
episodes.overview: Tonga is dispatched to Saturn's third moon after reports of trouble at the Cosmic Radiation Plant #1. Tonga's investigation leads the dismissal of the hot-tempered Captain Kronk. Kronk avows revenge and Tonga is shot with a shock rifle. Commander Corry and Cadet Happy arrive and rescue Tonga, but they are unable to capture Captain Kronk. However, they do arrest Kronk's assistant attempting to abscond with embezzled payroll accounts from the plant.

episodes.title: Solo Flight to Jupiter
episodes.overview: Cadet Happy makes his first solo flight to the Jupiter Space Port. Unfortunately, he acquires an unwelcome passenger named Lucky. Lucky is by trade an embezzler who is fleeing with Jupiter Trust Company's funds. To insure Happy's silence and cooperation, Lucky threatened to kill Carol and Commander Corry.

episodes.title: Cosmic Dedris Waring
episodes.overview: The United Planets Chief Astronomer discovers a planetoid has exploded. He sends an urgent report to Major Robertson at Space Control the debris posses a danger to all space raft in the area. Commander Corry, Cadet Lucky and Carol are returning to Terra from Earth when their space craft is struck by a meteor. They find themselves in dire straights: unable to navigate, unable to communicate, and venting oxygen through a hull rupture.
episodes.stream_name: Space Patrol (UK) S01E08 The Cloud of Death.mkv

episodes.title: The Planos Epidemic
episodes.overview: The owner of six lead mines on the moon Planos reports that an epidemic is spreading through the mines. Berger, the owner asks for assistance from the United Planets. Commander Corry, Tonga and Cadet Happy are dispatched on a rescue mission with the needed serum to halt the disease. However, Burger and his assistant are trying to keep quiet a secret discovery of a rich deposit of Exonium. Captain Happy discovers Leckner tampering with the atmospheric controls in one of the mine shafts. In a struggle with Cadet Happy, he unknowingly inhales a lethal dose of the concentrated bacteria.

episodes.title: Tunnel of Escape: Tunnel of Death
episodes.overview: Warden Sovak and his head trustee, Erik, have been arranging for prisoners to escape provided they can pay the appropriate fee. The prisoners are lead out through a tunnel which passes under an irrigation canal. After the report of three prisoners escaping the supposed escape-proof facility leads to an investigation. Commander Corry, Cadet Happy and Major Robertson carry out the inquiry.
